questions.title: Does the manual state these troubleshooting facts?

source.text: Problem: The Cutting Tool or Pen does not move down Description of Problem: The tool or Pen does not move down when cutting a file or they are delayed coming down at the beginning of a cut. This can be caused by an electrical short, tool mapping in software or a problem with the power supply.
Troubleshooting: 1.Make sure the gantry Tools ON switch is turned on. This can be verified by making sure the laser pointer is on.
4.Make sure you have pressure at the tools. Try pulling tool the holder down by hand to see if it has pressure.
6.The Pen or Tool delays coming down and misses the beginning of marker or cut.
a) Check the 24 VDC power supply located in the diagnos-
tic cabinet. Make sure the green led is on.
b) Check the 24 VDC power supply fuse.

proposal: 1. FailureMode 'Power supply problem' -> RESOLVED_BY -> CorrectiveAction 'Turn on the gantry Tools ON switch' [repair]. Meaning: The failure mode may be resolved by the specified corrective action. Conditions: Verify the switch is on by confirming the laser pointer is on.

2. Symptom 'Cutting tool or pen does not move down or is delayed coming down' -> MAY_INDICATE -> FailureMode 'Insufficient pressure at the tools'. Meaning: The symptom may indicate the specified failure mode.

3. Symptom 'Cutting tool or pen does not move down or is delayed coming down' -> MAY_INDICATE -> FailureMode '24 VDC power supply or fuse problem'. Meaning: The symptom may indicate the specified failure mode. Conditions: When the pen or tool delays coming down and misses the beginning of marker or cut.

answers.text: Keep statement 3 only; the manual links the delayed/missed-start symptom to checks of the 24 VDC power supply and fuse.
answers.rationale: The manual lists a power-supply problem as a possible cause and directs checking the 24 VDC supply and fuse for the delayed-start symptom, but it does not say the Tools ON switch resolves a power-supply problem or identify insufficient pressure as a cause.

answers.text: Keep statement 2 only. The excerpt says the mirrors may need adjustment if the test-pulse dot has a ring or partial ring, but does not state that the failure mode affects the mirrors.
answers.rationale: The test-pulse result is explicitly associated with the possibility that the mirrors need adjustment, but the excerpt does not establish the proposed AFFECTS relation.
The excerpt gives the symptom and troubleshooting actions but does not state that it indicates an unspecified failure mode.

answers.text: The manual states reduced vacuum, not absent vacuum.
answers.rationale: The manual identifies reduced vacuum in the laser fume extractor, but does not state absent vacuum as part of this problem.

answers.text: The manual does not state that a bent or misaligned tube/nozzle affects the mirrors; it says the nozzle may be bent, or the mirrors may need adjustment.
answers.rationale: The excerpt presents a bent nozzle and mirror adjustment as alternative explanations for the ring around the test-pulse dot, not as an effect of the bent tube/nozzle on the mirrors.
